title: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) Retail by Design
description: Infusion combines technology and beautiful design to transform RBC Royal Bank branches into retail stores of the future.

asr.full_text: Infusion is now out in space, which makes it easier to communicate with customers. Infusion was with us since the beginning of the journey We flipped our model so that the floor space is now 80% dedicated to the customers, our salespeople are out on the floor The content on the touch screens leverage a variety of things like gamification ideas, direct access to tools and calculators, direct access to advice tips, product information, promotional information and it's positioned in such a way that the sales person can easily switch and navigate if the customer decides to change the conversation to what's most relevant for them? The kiosks have been in the store for over two years since the the store has been converted I think it's wonderful because I can actually talk to the clients while they're on the floor I think sometimes when the clients think office they think, well I'm committed where out here on the floor it's a different experience for them. We can talk, we can share ideas Well, I have had it happen many times that when you've had a client in an office and you've asked them about whether they want to put money aside, they turn around and say, �No, I really don't want to do that.� But when you bring them out here, or when you've shown them how much they can save, and they can see how much they can save in just a year or two years, all of a sudden it's like, �Oh, I only have to put that much aside? ImFusion helped us really decide on what types of technology we were going to use in these stores. As of now we have 70 new retail concept stores, plus another 70 with a retail influence in the branches. Our sales people tell us it is absolutely what they've been waiting for all along. Infusion has creative services to envision how the branch should look and what kind of technology can be brought in. We've obviously got the engineering services to build out the experiences. It's got to be also about the support model and how to actually roll out to the stores so we've got a managed support desk that can help procure your hardware, install that hardware actually within the branch, and then support that hardware through the operating lifecycle of the experience. Infusion can be an end to end, one stop shop for any bank that wants to do their branch transformation strategy.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents RBC retail design and Infusion’s branch-transformation work as an ordinary B2B commercial service. The discussion of touchscreens, advice, product information, and possible savings describes branch interactions rather than an explicit guaranteed-return offer or stated payment condition. No deceptive solicitation or required transfer of money or data is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary B2B technology, design and operational support service for bank branches, including branch transformation, hardware installation and lifecycle support.
